name: chain_deep
description: A grounds B grounds C grounds D. Every node has exactly one supporter, which is the topology where foundationalism and Quine most sharply disagree: the foundationalist expects the whole chain to fall with A, the Quinean expects each hop to lose magnitude.
evidence_count_note: One evidence record each. Under DecayMode.PROVENANCE this fixes share at 1/(1+1) per hop, so the fixture's own provenance — not a constant — sets the decay rate.
